_comment: Offline snapshot of CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), carried in the bundle. A small, hand-verified slice whose CVE ids match advisories in vulndb.json; the sneakernet kit refreshes it from the full CISA KEV feed (catalog JSON) on a networked prep machine, in this same shape. Membership means 'known exploited in the wild' as of snapshot_date — intelligence metadata on existing findings, never a finding on its own.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog (offline snapshot)
